system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You’ve become the perfect symbol for the Vespers. A lodestar to aspire to become. A myth among the living and a legend for those not yet born. But this perfection isn’t absolute. You must make a choice. When you reach this level, choose between Dominion and Requiem. An Ultimatum in choice for which part of your clan you wish to represent. Once you make this choice, you can only change it by completing a ritual to do so, which can be done as part of a Full-Rest.

Dominion

You embody the shadows and fear, and the ability to compel at will.

When you roll initiative, you begin to radiate a small aura of shadows around yourself as the range of your blind sight from the Echolocation ability is increased to 40 feet.

Additionally, If you would ever teleport into a space that is dimly lit or in darkness that is adjacent to a creature that is Berserked, Charmed, Confused, Demoralized or Shaken, you can, as part of the same action used to teleport, force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, select one creature they can see that is in initiative. They must spend their movement, action and bonus action to harm the select creature. When they have dealt damage to the target creature 3 times, this effect ends on them. A creature that passes their save by 5 or more, becomes immune to this effect until you complete a rest.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Requiem

You embody the concept whispered about in your clan, the Apex Vampyr. A predator and stalker of the night that feeds on crimson ichor to sustain themselves.

When you roll initiative, your claws become crimson red and grow in length. While in the Claws of Night stance, or while in your Umbral Monarch state, you gain a +15 bonus to your movement speed and when you take the Attack action, can make one additional attack as part of that Action.

Also, creatures with ranks of Bleed or Crimson Hemorrhage, grant you a +1 bonus to your unarmed attacks or weapon attacks critical threat range.

Additionally, as a Bonus Action, creatures with ranks of Bleed or Crimson Hemorrhage within 30 feet of you have their blood siphoned from them, as they lose all ranks of the listed conditions. For every rank of the listed conditions removed, you regain 1d6 hit points or gain 6 Temporary hit points, your choice.
